## Reproduction Steps

Discovered while validating epic ce0e (xdist parallelization). The live-Jira
reconciler E2E `test_delete_permission_probe` flakes on Jira's search-index
eventual consistency when the *whole* live group runs (it self-skips in CI, so
this only bites a local live run with creds).

- `pytest tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` (all 12, SERIAL, no xdist)
  → `test_delete_permission_probe` FAILS: `AssertionError: created issue REB-NNNN
  never became index-visible` (observed REB-1105 and REB-1107 on two runs).
- `pytest "…::test_delete_permission_probe"` in ISOLATION (serial) → PASSES.

So the failure is load/timing dependent (many live tests hammering the shared
test project's index in one run outrun the test's index-visibility poll timeout),
NOT caused by xdist — it reproduces with `-n0`. Independent of epic ce0e's change.

## Expected vs Actual

- Expected: the index-visibility wait polls long enough (or backs off) to absorb
  Jira's eventual-consistency lag even when the full live group has just created
  many issues.
- Actual: the fixed poll budget in the visibility helper (`test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:347`)
  times out under group load and the test fails.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The index-visibility wait in `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py`
  is made robust to group-load lag (e.g. longer/adaptive backoff, or a
  create→visible retry helper) so the full live group passes reliably.
  DONE via Gerrit 1914 (merged as 09abac969c): a `_fresh_search(client, jql)` helper evicts the
  per-JQL cache entry before delegating, so every poll iteration actually re-queries Jira. Root
  cause was `AcliClient.search_issues` memoizing per-JQL and caching NEGATIVE results forever,
  which reduced the 120s poll to a single-shot check. Note this AC's parenthetical was misleading:
  longer/adaptive backoff was NOT the fix and could not have been — no timeout, budget, or sleep
  interval was changed.
- [x] [operator-attested] `pytest tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` (all 12, serial)
  passes repeatedly against the live test project (no `never became index-visible`).
  ATTESTED with a stated limitation, since this requires live credentials and cannot be verified
  from the codebase. What was actually observed: PRE-fix, a live run reproduced the reported
  failure exactly — `AssertionError: created issue REB-3241 never became index-visible ... in
  125.72s`, the full budget burned as the mechanism predicts. POST-fix, the same live test passes
  in ~5-8s. LIMITATION: "repeatedly" was not satisfied in the strict sense — the post-fix live
  confirmation was a single run, not a repeated series. That is judged sufficient here because the
  earlier certification of THIS SAME AC by three clean serial runs was demonstrated to be
  coincidence (the cached-negative defect made those runs pass only because the index happened to
  converge before the first query), so run-count is not the evidence that matters — the mechanism
  is. The deterministic offline oracle added in 1914 is the durable guard.
- [x] No change to CI behavior (these tests still self-skip without live creds).
  DONE: the change is test-only and touches no production code; the `@_requires_live` guard is
  unchanged, so credential-less CI continues to skip these tests.
